infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Future Jobs Pro AI to use your camera for job site photos
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Future Jobs Pro AI uses your location to record where you clock in and out, verify your presence at a job site (e.g., when you start work at 123 Main Street), and show nearby crew members on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Your location is shared with your company during an active work shift, including when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Future Jobs Pro AI uses the microphone for voice notes and to detect ‘Hey Lucy’ locally while the app is open and listening is enabled.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Future Jobs Pro AI uses speech recognition to allow you to control the app with your voice.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Future Jobs Pro AI to record your location during an active work shift, including when the app is in the background.
